title: Patchcord application manifest (v1)
description: The patchcord-app.yaml manifest an installed application declares (vision doc §7.6, §9.3, §15.4). This is the minimal, versioned slice of the eventual permission model: it only covers workflows.run today. connectors.use and capabilities are deliberately not part of v1 — see ADR-0026 — and will land in a later, additive schema revision once the agent has an enforcement point for them.

id.description: Unique identifier of the application, used in its serving URL (/apps/{id}/) and in the sessions it issues.

run.description: Workflow ids this application's sessions are allowed to run. A session issued for this application can never run a workflow outside this list.
